question: Should OpenClaw expose a plugin-visible post-install/update skill lifecycle observer, and which redacted outcome/audit fields and failure semantics should that public contract allow?
rationale: The remaining work is a security-sensitive plugin API contract; automation can identify the missing observer but cannot choose the privacy boundary, fail-open behavior, or whether standalone ClawHub CLI events belong in this repo.

options.title: Add a redacted observer
options.body: Extend the existing install lifecycle with a best-effort post-install/update observer for OpenClaw-managed skill installs and document the allowed metadata.

options.title: Keep pre-install only
options.body: Close the product direction around blocking policy only and tell scanners/auditors to use `security.installPolicy`, telemetry, or ClawHub-owned integrations for completion auditing.

options.title: Move completion auditing to ClawHub
options.body: Keep OpenClaw core unchanged and track post-install audit/compliance integration in ClawHub or plugin-owned infrastructure instead.

recommendation.title: Add a redacted observer
recommendation.body: Extend the existing install lifecycle with a best-effort post-install/update observer for OpenClaw-managed skill installs and document the allowed metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest recent history on the current hook and install lifecycle code that would define the remaining API boundary.
